master.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production complete vehicle game master: sand beige all-terrain 6x6 cargo truck, carrying fourteen-tonne broken-down smaller 6x6 truck chained on a recovery deck; three smaller LOAD tires stay attached to that truck well above road tires. Equipment: snorkel and wading kit. Thick dried mud and weathered materials. Approved Swamp Scout premium semi-realistic painted illustration, readable dark contours, rich natural textures, fine mechanical detail. Reference 1 style only; reference 2 strict perpendicular camera and mechanical construction only; reference 3 tire/rim. Facing RIGHT. Exactly 3 near-side ROAD tires: one front steer axle at right and CLOSE rear tandem at left, directly supporting load. All tires 1.75 m off-road mud-terrain tires wrapped in heavy steel V-bar cleated chains. Total length 10 m = 5.714 tire diameters, under 16.8 m including load. Secured cargo and all equipment stowed. Horizontal chassis/deck/load, level hubs and tire bottoms. strictly flat 2D side profile, camera perpendicular to the near side at hub height, no perspective, all tires the same size on one level line, no far-side tires. Real conventional short-bonnet heavy-truck cab; separate bonnet radiator housing blunt bumper headlamp and round-clearance front fender with clean seams. Small rectangular mirror at A-pillar on short rigid brackets. No melted fused wedge panels or floating mirrors. All road tires fully visible; no front grille face or bed end face visible. Wide PNG intended 2048 x 1024, at least 1500 pixels across, generous 5% clear margins ALL sides. True transparent background and internal gaps. Soft even daylight. No text logos watermark ground shadow glow halo scenery. IMPORTANT load separation: exactly THREE full-size road wheels on the ground line, plus exactly THREE smaller wheels on the broken-down 6x6 load truck, resting on the recovery deck. The load truck is a compact conventional short-bonnet olive 6x6, facing right in the same strict side profile. No trailer. Recovery deck load securely chained, deck horizontal. Main cab remains sand beige.
